question: Seven boxes L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. M is kept fourth from the bottom. O is placed immediately below M. Q is placed immediately above R. P is the topmost box. M is placed immediately below L. Which box is placed at the bottom?
solution:
Seven boxes L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• M is kept fourth from the bottom.
 
• O is placed immediately below M.
 
• Q is placed immediately above R.
 
• P is the topmost box.
 
• M is placed immediately below L

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
P

 
 
 

 
 
N

 
 
 

 
 
L

 
 
 

 
 
M

 
 
 

 
 
O

 
 
 

 
 
Q

 
 
 

 
 
R

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
